message.content:
{
 "summary": "Unusual plant behaviour (correlation broken) alarm has been raised for the pH correction and coagulation area, with the anomaly monitor showing a value of 45.1 against a limit of 12.0. The top contributor is AIT-201B at 0.83, indicating a disagreement between the pH correction tank probes AIT-201 (now 7.30 pH) and AIT-201B (now 7.07 pH) due to a drifting or fouled pH probe.",
 "likely_causes": [
  "Fouling of the probe by dye, fibre lint or calcium deposits.",
  "Reference junction poisoning, or an ageing electrode past its service life.",
  "Water in the cable gland or a damaged probe cable."
 ],
 "checks": [
  "Take a grab sample from the pH correction tank and measure it with the calibrated hand-held meter.",
  "Compare the hand-held reading with AIT-201, AIT-201B and the discharge pH AIT-501.",
  "Check when each probe was last calibrated (calibration log) and whether it is due.",
  "Inspect the probe for coating and the cable for damage.",
  "Compare the control probe AIT-201 with the check probe AIT-201B."
 ],
 "handover": "Investigated unusual plant behaviour alarm caused by pH probe disagreement in area 200. Checked AIT-201 (7.30 pH) and AIT-201B (7.07 pH) and noted AIT-201B as the top anomaly contributor. Pending grab sample verification and probe inspection according to SOP-03.",
 "citations": [
  "SOP-03 3.2",
  "SOP-03 3.3",
  "SOP-03 3.4",
  "SOP-02 2.4"
 ]
}
